discussion:
Imported from role task file `tasks/section_17/cis_17.5.x.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS` and Audit control `section_17/cis_17.5.x/cis_17.5.1.yml` of `ansible-lockdown/Windows-11-CIS-Audit`. The CIS Benchmark text is not part of this source.

Manual: the Ansible role fixes this with commands that have no matching check, so the commands are shown as the fix, plus the original Ansible and goss test.

steps.name: Original Ansible tasks
steps.shell:
- name: "17.5.1 | PATCH | Ensure Audit Account Lockout is set to include Failure"
  when: win11cis_rule_17_5_1
  tags:
    - level1-corporate-enterprise-environment
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_17.5.1
    - audit_account_lockout
    - NIST800-171_3.3.1
    - NIST800-171_3.3.2
    - NIST800-171_3.3.6
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-12
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-3
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-3_1
    - NIST800-53R5_AU-7
  block:
    - name: "17.5.1 | AUDIT | Ensure Audit Account Lockout is set to include Failure | Get current audit events"
      ansible.windows.win_shell: AuditPol /get /subcategory:"Account Lockout" -r | ConvertFrom-Csv | Select-Object -expand "Inclusion Setting"
      changed_when: false
      check_mode: false
      failed_when: false
      register: discovered_17_5_1_audit

    - name: "17.5.1 | PATCH | Ensure Audit Account Lockout is set to include Failure | Failure"
      when: "'Failure' not in discovered_17_5_1_audit.stdout"
      ansible.windows.win_shell: AuditPol /set /subcategory:"Account Lockout" /failure:enable
